title.narrative: Irrigation Water Security, Resilience and Value-Addition Project

description.narrative: The project will focus on the irrigation sub-sector. It aims at supporting irrigated agriculture in public irrigation schemes, through: (i) strengthened performance of the operator of the irrigation service; (ii) modernized irrigation infrastructure, reducing losses and ensuring more flexible access to water; and (iii) improved agricultural value addition, productivity and market access.
To improve the quality of irrigation water services; to strengthen the operational performance of the irrigation operators; and to increase crop yields.
